manifest.name: research-report
manifest.description: Evidence-backed research pipeline: research → verify → draft.

nodes.task: Research {{topic}} using current primary sources. Collect key facts, viewpoints, and source URLs at {{depth}} depth. Return a structured evidence brief.
Independently verify the most load-bearing claims about {{topic}}: check source authority, recency, and contradictions. Mark each claim verified, partially verified, or unverified with reasons.

Draft a report on {{topic}} for a {{audience}}: include a one-paragraph summary, structured findings, and a source list. Include only claims that survived verification and mark uncertainty explicitly.

intent: Research a topic, independently verify the evidence, and produce a concise report.

audience.description: Who the report is written for.
